notes.title: "Ancient Cultivatrix" 1.0.1 Official Version Update Notes
notes.content:
Thank you all for your continued support! We wish you happiness every day (^▽^):

[b]I. Feature Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Added the storyline for Violet Moon.
[*] Since auto-attack is now permanent, we've removed the redundant talent [Pickup Range] from the Dao Altar.
[*] Added a new talent [Luck] in the Dao Altar.
[*] The probability of extracting Qi Luck for artifacts has been increased from 100% to 500%.
[*] Optimized the Fire Sword Dance bond.
[*] Optimized background music for some levels.
[/list]

[b]II. Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where the achievement [Craft 61 Different Elixirs] did not trigger.
[*] Fixed the bug with the item [Broken Life Altar] incorrectly deducting HP. Using this item now shouldn't result in instant death… hopefully... (Don’t be too greedy!).
[/list]

notes.title: "Ancient Cultivatrix" EA 0.0.8 Version Update Notes
notes.content:
Endless Mode is way too OP, so here’s one last small update before the New Year.
Wishing you good fortune and prosperity in the coming year!

[b]I. Feature Improvements[/b]

Optimized item purchasing in Endless Mode—sacrificial relics will no longer get wiped from the inventory.

Adjusted attribute balance for Endless Mode.

[b]II. Bug Fixes
[/b]
Fixed a bug where the purple ginseng spirit’s HP would skyrocket, making it unkillable.

Fixed an issue where switching skins in the Luck menu wouldn’t display the change.

notes.title: "Ancient Cultivatrix" New version of Demon Dane and Endless mode
notes.content:
Happy Lunar New Year, friends!
The Endless Mode and a new weapon, Demon Core, are here! 
Wishing you great fortune and success in the Year of the Snake.
 Thank you for your continued support and companionship.
________________________________________

I. Feature Improvements

1.	New Endless Mode: Unlockable after defeating the boss. Keep fighting and enjoy the thrill!
2.	New Weapon - Demon Core: Now available in battles.
3.	Added a new Endless Talents tab in the Daoist Altar interface. Players can use Endless Essence earned in battles to unlock exclusive Endless Mode talents.
4.	Added close-up displays for new resources.
5.	Revamped the introductory storyline for new players at the start of the game.
6.	Fixed the awkward issue of characters not having their magazines refilled after completing tutorial sections.
7.	Added guidance and tutorial explanations for Endless Mode.
8.	Improved inventory sorting rules in the distribution interface. You can now sort items with one click.
________________________________________

II. Bug Fixes

1.	Fixed a bug where Talent Pills might disappear from the list after being crafted.
2.	Updated deprecated alchemy recipes from older versions to the newly designated recipes.
________________________________________

Enjoy the new content, and may the Endless Mode bring you endless fun!

notes.title: "Ancient Cultivatrix" EA 0.0.6 Version Update Notes
notes.content:
Happy weekend, everyone! This is a minor update focusing on optimizations and small bug fixes. Thank you all for your continued support and company!
________________________________________
I. Feature Optimizations
1.	Improved auto-settings: manual changes will now carry over to the next level.
2.	Enhanced text descriptions for certain Fortune items.
3.	Added a confirmation popup for Fortune unlocks.
4.	Optimized display rules and interface for Fortune draws.
________________________________________
II. Bug Fixes
1.	Fixed a recovery bug with the [Overlapping Thunder] skill when picking up health potions.
2.	Resolved an issue where the [Immortal Hermit] boss could get stuck during movement interactions.
________________________________________
Enjoy the game and have a wonderful weekend! 🎉

notes.title: "Ancient Cultivatrix" EA 0.0.5 Version Update Notes
notes.content:
We've made some improvements and fixed a few strange bugs. Thank you all for your support and companionship—we’ll continue to work hard to bring you an even better gaming experience! Here’s the update log:
________________________________________

[b]I. Feature Improvements[/b]

1.	Optimized monster interaction hierarchy.
2.	Improved cloud save settings.
3.	Enhanced compatibility for various resolutions.
4.	Pop-up dialogue windows will no longer block the screen during camera movement.
5.	Added stage display and character switch hotkeys in the shop allocation interface.
6.	Improved the back button functionality during story scenes.
7.     Changed realm upgrade effects from attack speed boosts to cooldown reduction for skill recovery.
8.     Refined the alchemy tutorial—avoid the red paths with residue, the cauldron can be explode!
________________________________________

[b]II. Bug Fixes[/b]

1.	Fixed an issue where summoned monsters did not inherit elemental attributes.
2.	Fixed an issue where exiting mid-alchemy could result in lost elixirs.
3.	Fixed a bug where the game could freeze after completing the 7th level: Shadow Domain storyline.
4.	Fixed a bug where enemy summons could receive player buffs.

notes.title: Ancient Cultivatrix EA 0.0.4 Version Update
notes.content:
Alright, as you wished, all summoned creatures have now evolved into vampire servants! Plus, we’ve added the ultimate convenience feature—Auto Fortune. Once unlocked, it enables auto-combat, auto-loot, auto-eating, and even auto-sleeping!

Thank you once again for your support and company. We will keep working hard to bring you an even better gaming experience! Below is the update log:

[b]1. Feature Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Auto Fortune: Enables auto-attack and auto-loot after being unlocked at the Taoist Altar.
[*] Optimized stage difficulty: Added new items that reduce monster health and attack.
[*] Improved summoned creatures to inherit the lifesteal ability from the character.
[*] Refined the text description for character healing targets.
[*] The "Flame Paper Protection" skill now heals all team members and summons.
[*] Buffed the summoned creatures from the Matriarch: they now come with built-in taunts and have a shorter attack cooldown.
[*] Increased the chances of getting weapons when refreshing the shop.
[*] Toned down those annoying ginseng spirits—they’re now much weaker and easier to defeat!
[/list]

[b]2. Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where dodges during combat caused the target effect to trigger multiple times.
[/list]

notes.title: The Power of Summoning Flag is on the Way
notes.content:
When the game first launched, we received a lot of feedback from players about text box layout issues and the pressure of mouse interactions. We’re aware of these concerns and are working to improve the experience as quickly as possible.

On the other hand, many players also mentioned that the combat difficulty was too high—some even got stuck on the first level for an entire afternoon. We’re truly sorry about that... To address this, we’re introducing the new “Summoning Flag” weapon in an upcoming update.

The Summoning Playstyle is a blessing for players who enjoy chaotic, large-scale battles. By summoning a multitude of units to act as shields or provide firepower support, you can push your squad's combat capabilities to their limit.

[b]Playstyle Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Overwhelming Numbers:
[/list]
Skills such as "Summon Beasts" or "Spirit Command" allow summoned units to inherit a portion of the character's HP and attack power, giving you a numbers advantage.

[list]
[*] Diverse Combinations:
[/list]
When paired with abilities like “Buddha Trap” or “Soul Nurture,” summoning skills can also inflict various debuffs, putting enemies in a controlled state.

[list]
[*] Team Enhancements:
[/list]
Summoned units not only serve as shields but also trigger effects like parasitism, upgrades, or secondary summons, improving your team’s survivability and damage output.

[b]Recommended Builds:[/b]
[list]
[*] Equipment:
[/list]
Prioritize items that enhance the HP and attack power of summoned units.

[list]
[*] Team Composition:
[/list]
Combine summoning-focused characters with support-oriented ones to create an efficient and safe combat environment.

Under the dominance of the summoning playstyle, turn the battlefield into an all-out brawl! Use your thick walls of summoned allies to crush the enemy’s offensive momentum and reclaim control of the fight.

notes.title: "Ancient Cultivatrix" EA 0.0.2 Version Update Notes
notes.content:
Among the suggestions we've received, some players have expressed a desire for an auto-battle option and a less demanding combat experience.

To balance the needs of manual control players and those who prefer auto-battle, the development team is introducing ：[h3][b]The Banner Weapon Style[/b][/h3] !This style allows you to summon minions to assist in battle, effectively reducing the overall operational complexity so that everyone can find a playstyle that suits them.

Of course, we’re carefully reviewing every piece of feedback and will continue improving the game experience step by step. Your input is invaluable—thank you so much!

Additionally, to show our appreciation for your support, we will be holding an event where all players will receive 10 DLC skins for all characters (including the story reward skin for Long Xi). The DLC is currently awaiting Steam approval, and since the review process might be delayed due to the holiday season, we kindly ask for your patience. We’ll notify you as soon as the event goes live!

Thank you again for your support and companionship. We will keep pushing forward to bring you an even better gaming experience!

I. Feature Improvements
Overall difficulty of dungeons has been reduced.
Spirit stone pickup radius increased by 50%, and the pickup detection threshold has been lowered.
Added beginner tip bubbles in the camp.
Adjusted some abstract IDs in the crowdfunding gratitude list.
Reduced basic attack cooldown by 20%.
II. Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where Ye Wuying's level 1 skill taunt did not take effect.
Fixed a configuration issue in Bai Xingye’s story content.

notes.content:
[i]When you first awaken on the blood-stained altar, you're bewildered.
But by the tenth resurrection, you've mastered the secret of escaping death.
"As payment, offer me the Lifespan crystalline..." the altar whispers in your ear.
"If you are truly the Chosen One, then I am at your service," the cultivatrix vows before you.
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839354/f739c93b2cb8f1f1c1bad6d2460cf35bdd5c53b0.jpg[/img]

In "Ancient Cultivatrix," assist the cultivatrix in honing their Taoist energy and advancing their spiritual journey. Perhaps this time, you'll unveil the enigmatic truth.

Welcome to my Discord community：[url=https://discord.gg/S7G9jM3fYh]Discord - @five shrimps[/url]
X : [url=https://x.com/5_shrimps]@5_shrimps[/url]

[h3]Demo contains the following:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Encounter with Fair Maiden
[/list]By a twist of fate, you encounter some young girls. Through daily interactions, you gradually earn their trust and reliance. However, in this fallen realm, formidable foes lurk at every turn, this cultivation adventure is fraught with challenges.
To nurture the potential of these cultivatrices and study the ancient arts of cultivation together. You might even reach the threshold of the divine realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839354/c22506cb5497d598f784b89924c9f00daddedf21.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Fire Projectiles to Fight
[/list]30+ monster encyclopedia: Those who glimpsed the Old Ones have been corrupted into malevolent minions. This forbidden land is rife with danger, and fierce battles are inevitable.
10+ The Old Fallen Lord: These bosses are forbidden entities, wandering in the abyss. Defeat them before the world crumbles...
You'll lead an elite squad, carving a bloody path to victory. In the later stages, an Endless Purgatory challenge mode is also included to play through!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839354/514d41f95f7bd01cc586b7c1714f2f182e4fa5bf.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Flexible Matching Strategies
[/list]25+ combat systems: Five types of weapons combined with five elemental attributes give rise to dozens of skills, helping you gain a strategic advantage.
20+ bond system: Tides' chant, Fine star blade... These talents each excel in different battle situations. But it's up to you, the leader, to make crucial decisions.
150+ ancient artifacts: Wind-borne chime, arctic fox skull... These items, long forgotten in the corners of battlefields, silently await the next host.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839354/0178d5e95d4dbcc5fb12b12d96781a8413f1b9c5.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Refine an Elixir and Sell It
[/list]After your adventures, your backpack is crammed with sticky eyeballs and sharp fangs. Use them to refine elixirs, mastering this ancient art until you reach the pinnacle of perfection.
Meanwhile, mysterious strangers await outside, crave for your elixirs. Trade with them to obtain Lifespan crystalline, and sacrifice it to the altar to gain mysterious powers.
